name: How do Denver-area storm patterns influence interior storm restoration?

mainEntity.name: How do Denver-area storm patterns influence interior storm restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver, Aurora, and the greater Front Range, severe summer hailstorms and heavy spring snow loads frequently breach roofs or ice dam gutters, pushing water into attics and exterior wall cavities. Rapid temperature swings in this region can also freeze and burst supply lines exposed to drafts after storm-related siding damage. Restoring Front Range interiors requires careful attention to vapor barriers, thorough attic insulation replacement, and checking exterior framing bays for hidden moisture driven deep inside by high plains winds.
acceptedAnswer.description: Front Range hail and heavy snow push moisture deep into attics and wall cavities, requiring careful attic insulation replacement and moisture checks.
